//: AIR acquisition colors only; never changes actual drops. Best supported route wins. Adjust per-source probability by location difficulty before applying thresholds. Creature evidence includes the weighted species mix per defeated encounter and full butchery; search evidence includes all rolls, zero-count outcomes and availability gates. Crafting inherits the hardest required ingredient using the easiest loaded alternative; skill and item-specific tier overrides never promote rarity. Unknown acquisition remains neutral.
//loot: Loot title colors use the greatest baseline find probability across loot sources, with no crafting, trade or danger bonus. Below 0.1% is epic; below 0.01% is legendary. Actual availability gates, not labels, keep selected finds scarce.

exploration.//: Independent per-tier floor rolls only when normal exploration produced none of that tier. Deliberately bypass per-item availability gates. Classifications remain based on baseline sources, so the bonus cannot reclassify its own pool.
